line_endings: Local Git checkout is CRLF; normalized LF SHA256 matches the original manifest for all four vendored files. Runtime byte hashes are separately frozen below.

adaptations.TimeConvCNN: Exact archived STFT224-bin/timeconv/full ResNet18/projection128 encoder, scratch weights; n_times500/sfreq250; separate head after differentiable full-window/seizure mean-SD pooling. Not published official60s Morlet CNN.
adaptations.EEGNet: PyTorch EEGNet-8,2-adapted: half-second temporal125, depthwise spatial Chans1 degeneracy, separable temporal31, pooling4/8, dropout0.5; mean-SD aggregation and single binary head; spatial maxnorm1 and head maxnorm0.25.
adaptations.SEEGNet: Exact archived multiscale temporal/SE/residual/BiLSTM/temporal attention encoder at n_times500/sfreq250; head after full-window/seizure pooling. SEEG-Net-adapted, not official paper protocol.
adaptations.SEEGformer: Exact archived FFT frontend and masked transformer blocks;500samples/fs250/FFT1000,0.5-125Hz; three branches and branch-weighted classifier retained; expose post-transformer channel embeddings and aggregate differentiably before heads. Head input expands64to128 for mean-SD. No MRI/coordinates or patient-specific supervised tuning. Cross-patient adapted protocol.
